summary: 6-phase, 5-hour plan implementing detection only (research falsified every loader-defect hypothesis; staleness is structural pull-only regeneration). Wave 1: stamp source_git_head in state.lua's mark_loaded (sibling to the existing source_dir field, silently omitted when unresolvable) and author a standalone always-exit-0 check-deploy-freshness.sh registered in core's manifest. Wave 2: isolated temp-root test suite pinning stale/fresh/missing-field/unverifiable/path-scoping cases. Wave 3: non-blocking, existence-guarded call at the end of command-gate-in.sh's gate_in, after lock acquisition, preserving all six exports and every return code. Wave 4: both-directions acceptance demonstration through the real gate-in path with measured added preflight cost. Wave 5: 'Detecting When You're Stale' section in regeneration-is-manual-only.md. Non-goals: no copy-engine change, no install-extension.sh change, no per-file hash manifest, no blocking behavior.
